segments.text:
V. 23.
That all men may honour the Son, even as they honour the Father— Either willingly, and ſo eſcaping Condemnation, by Faith; or unwillingly, when feeling the Wrath of the Judge. This demonſtrates the EQUALITY of the Son with the Father. If our LORD were GOD only by Office or Inveſtiture, and not in the Unity of the divine Eſſence, and in all Reſpects equal in Godhead with the Father, He could not be honoured even as, that is, with the ſame Honour that they honoured the Father. He that honoureth not the Son—With the ſame equal Honour, greatly diſhonoureth the Father that ſent him.
